composition_variation: Create an original cinematic anime portrait of Naruto Uzumaki seated at a narrow ramen counter on a peaceful evening. Show his recognizable spiky blond hair, blue eyes, cheek marks, orange-and-black jacket, and relaxed happy expression. His hands rest naturally beside a steaming bowl, with chopsticks laid flat on the counter. Place him in the lower-middle frame, surrounded by warm amber wood, a small blue window reflection, and gentle steam fading into a broad quiet upper wall. Design for native 1024x1536 portrait format: important forms inside x158..866, faces inside x240..784. Leave the upper 28 percent quiet for the lock-screen clock. Use an original composition, no copied frames or promotional layout, text, logos, UI, weapons, fighting, extra characters, or distorted anatomy.
